dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, high-contrast light-toned ring geometries; one distinct closed 'O' structure on the mid-lateral flank with a jagged perimeter; several larger, open 'C' shaped structures above it forming an interconnected lattice with sharp transitions from dark exterior to light interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid high-intensity pixel points clustered in the cervical and cranial-dorsal regions; density decreases along the mid-lateral plane as macro-annuli become more dominant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Triangular geometric relationship formed by the centroids of the prominent mid-lateral 'O' ring, the adjacent dorsal-lateral 'C' structure, and a distinct high-intensity cluster located posterior to the ocular region.

other_distinctive_markers: A pervasive reticulated network of high-contrast, light-toned polygons covering the dorsal and lateral regions, creating a mosaic-like appearance.
